statement: The actual kernel of G_K(3) to the free rank-two unramified-outside3 quotient is the continuous free pro3 product of all inertia groups above primes outside3. A chosen pair of conjugate Frobenius lifts at7 gives an equivariant split extension. No splitting makes every local Frobenius correction an inertia element. For this chosen split, the cubic Kummer character of2 detects correction value2 at the prime (-2+3*zeta) above19. Exact cocycle reconstruction, operator compatibility, local tame relation, rational descent and conjugacy maps are given.
notes: Wingberg Theorem2.4 and Proposition2.1 were opened directly in the author PDF. All its hypotheses are checked using the cyclotomic Z3 extension and S containing3. The correction h_q=F_q s(sigma_q)^-1 is retained in the exact local equation; its finite Kummer image is explicitly computed from residues at7 and19. The all-splittings assertion follows by applying abelian Chebotarev to the ramified character of2 and its unramified restriction along the splitting. This gives an exact comparison and a proved obstruction to discarding the correction words; it does not claim to evaluate all their higher metabelian coordinates.
